name: find_cells
author: hprebar
title: Find cells
description: Search for matching text, numbers, or formula patterns across a worksheet or entire workbook. Returns matched cell addresses and values. Read-only.
notes: Uses Range.Find loop with proper wrap detection.

query.description: Text or value to search for.

sheet.description: Worksheet name to search. Defaults to active sheet.

workbook.description: Workbook name or file path. Defaults to active workbook.

lookIn.description: Look in cell values or formulas.

exactMatch.description: Match entire cell contents vs substring.

searchAllSheets.description: If true, searches across all worksheets in the workbook.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of matched cells to return.
